ingredients.name: Abiyuch
ingredients.whatItIs: Abiyuch comes from Crateva religiosa, commonly known as the sacred garlic pear or temple plant. It's a species of flowering tree that belongs to the caper family.

ingredients.name: Abondance
ingredients.whatItIs: Abondance is a semi-hard, fragrant, raw-milk cheese made in the Haute-Savoie department of France.

ingredients.name: Acid
ingredients.whatItIs: Acids are substances which increase the acidity of a foodstuff and/or impart a sour taste to it.

ingredients.name: Acidity regulator
ingredients.whatItIs: Acidity regulators are substances which alter or control the acidity or alkalinity of a foodstuff.

ingredients.name: Added sugar
ingredients.whatItIs: Added sugar is an ingredient that describes anything that counts as sugar.

ingredients.name: Adenosine monophosphate
ingredients.whatItIs: ADENOSINE MONOPHOSPHATE -AMP- is a nucleotide. AMP plays an important role in many cellular metabolic processes

ingredients.name: Alaska pollock
ingredients.whatItIs: The Alaska pollock -Gadus chalcogrammus- is a marine fish species of the cod family Gadidae.

ingredients.name: Albacore
ingredients.whatItIs: The albacore -Thunnus alalunga-, known also as the longfin tuna, is a species of tuna of the order Perciformes.

ingredients.name: Alkaline noodles
ingredients.whatItIs: variation of noodles with a much higher quantity of alkali than usual. The most common examples are Chinese Lamian noodles and Japanese Ramen noodles.

ingredients.name: Allspice
ingredients.whatItIs: ALLSPICE, also known as Jamaica pepper, myrtle pepper, pimenta, or pimento, is the dried unripe berry of Pimenta dioica, a midcanopy tree native to the Greater Antilles, southern Mexico, and Central America, now cultivated in many warm parts of the world.

ingredients.name: Aloe vera
ingredients.whatItIs: ALOE VERA is a succulent plant species of the genus Aloe.

ingredients.name: American sea scallop
ingredients.whatItIs: Placopecten magellanicus, common names Atlantic deep-sea scallop, deep sea scallop, North Atlantic sea scallop, American sea scallop, Atlantic sea scallop, or sea scallop, is a commercially important pectinid bivalve mollusk native to the northwest Atlantic Ocean.

ingredients.name: Aniseed
ingredients.whatItIs: Anise, also called aniseed, is a flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is widely cultivated and used to flavor food and alcoholic drinks, especially around the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: Anti-caking agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Anti-caking agents are substances which reduce the tendency of individual particles of a foodstuff to adhere to one another.

ingredients.name: Anti-foaming agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Anti-foaming agents are substances which prevent or reduce foaming.

ingredients.name: Antioxidant
ingredients.whatItIs: Antioxidants are substances which prolong the shelf-life of foods by protecting them against deterioration caused by oxidation, such as fat rancidity and colour changes.

ingredients.name: Apple juice
synonyms: apple juice made from fresh apples

ingredients.name: Apricot juice from concentrate and puree
synonyms: Apricot juice made from cremogenate and concentrate

ingredients.name: Arctic char
ingredients.whatItIs: The Arctic char or Arctic charr -Salvelinus alpinus- is a cold-water fish in the family Salmonidae, native to alpine lakes and arctic and subarctic coastal waters. The flesh is fine-flaked and medium firm. The colour is between light pink and deep red, and the taste is like something between trout and salmon.

ingredients.name: Argan oil
ingredients.whatItIs: argan oil is found in argan tree

ingredients.name: Arrowhead
ingredients.whatItIs: Arrowhead -also called Sagittaria, water arrowhead, or 慈姑 cí gū in Chinese- is an aquatic plant whose starchy corms -bulb-like root tubers- are eaten as a vegetable. It grows in shallow ponds, marshes, and rice paddies, and is especially popular in Chinese, Japanese, and Southeast Asian cooking. Mildly bitter and slightly sweet, with a starchy texture similar to a chestnut or potato. The bitterness mellows considerably with cooking.

ingredients.name: Arrowroot
ingredients.whatItIs: Arrowroot -Maranta arundinacea- is a tropical plant native to the Caribbean and Central/South America. It's a rhizome — an underground stem, similar in concept to ginger or turmeric. Arrowroot is most famous as a starch/thickener rather than a table vegetable.

ingredients.name: Arrowtooth flounder
ingredients.whatItIs: The arrowtooth flounder -Atheresthes stomas- is a fish in the family Pleuronectidae.

ingredients.name: Artichoke
ingredients.whatItIs: The globe ARTICHOKE -Cynara cardunculus var. scolymus-, also known as French artichoke and green artichoke in the USA, is a variety of a species of thistle cultivated as a food. Leaves are often removed one at a time, and the fleshy base eaten, with hollandaise, vinegar, butter, mayonnaise, aioli, lemon juice, or other sauces. The fibrous upper part of each leaf is usually discarded. The heart is eaten when the inedible choke has been peeled away from the base and discarded. The thin leaves covering the choke are also edible.

ingredients.name: Artichoke heart
ingredients.whatItIs: The heart is eaten when the inedible choke has been peeled away from the base and discarded.

ingredients.name: Asafoetida
ingredients.whatItIs: A resinous gum from the stem and roots of Ferula species such as Ferula foetida and Ferula assa-foetida, having a strong, unpleasant smell, with culinary and medical uses

ingredients.name: Ashitaba
ingredients.whatItIs: species of flowering plant in the carrot family

ingredients.name: Asiago
ingredients.whatItIs: Asiago is an Italian cow's milk cheese that can assume different textures, according to its aging, from smooth for the fresh Asiago to a crumbly texture for the aged cheese.

ingredients.name: Asparagus
ingredients.whatItIs: Asparagus, or garden asparagus, folk name sparrow grass, scientific name Asparagus officinalis is a spring vegetable, a flowering perennial plant species in the genus Asparagus;

ingredients.name: Atlantic salmon
ingredients.whatItIs: The Atlantic salmon -Salmo salar- is a species of ray-finned fish in the family Salmonidae.

ingredients.name: Atlantic wolffish
ingredients.whatItIs: The Atlantic wolffish -Anarhichas lupus-, also known as the seawolf, Atlantic catfish, ocean catfish, devil fish, wolf eel -the common name for its Pacific relative-, woof or sea cat, is a marine fish of the wolffish family Anarhichadidae.

ingredients.name: Avocado
ingredients.whatItIs: The AVOCADO -Persea americana- is a tree classified as a member of the flowering plant family Lauraceae. The fruit of the plant, also called an avocado, is botanically a large berry containing a single large seed.

ingredients.name: Babassu oil
ingredients.whatItIs: Babassu oil is a light, natural vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of the babassu palm tree -Orbignya phalerata-, native to the Amazon rainforest region of Brazil. It's also valued for its sustainability credentials, as harvesting supports traditional Amazonian communities -particularly women harvesters known as quebradeiras de coco-.

ingredients.name: Baker's yeast
ingredients.whatItIs: Baker's yeast is the common name for the strains of yeast commonly used as a leavening agent in baking bread and bakery products

ingredients.name: Bamboo
ingredients.whatItIs: The bamboos are evergreen perennial flowering plants in the subfamily Bambusoideae of the grass family Poaceae.

ingredients.name: Bamboo shoot
ingredients.whatItIs: Bamboo shoots or bamboo sprouts are the edible shoots -new bamboo culms that come out of the ground- of many bamboo species including Bambusa vulgaris and Phyllostachys edulis.

ingredients.name: Barley
ingredients.whatItIs: A cereal grain, also widely used as malt.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used in breads, cereals, soups, beer and as malt extract for flavour and colour.
ingredients.riskReason: A nutritious wholegrain. It contains gluten, so it must be declared and avoided by people with coeliac disease.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Basmati rice
ingredients.whatItIs: BASMATI RICE is a variety of long, slender-grained aromatic rice which is traditionally from the Indian subcontinent.

ingredients.name: Bastardo
ingredients.whatItIs: Trousseau or Trousseau Noir, also known as Bastardo, is an old variety of red wine grape originating in eastern France.

ingredients.name: Beans
ingredients.whatItIs: A BEAN is a seed of one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

ingredients.name: Béarnaise sauce
ingredients.whatItIs: BÉARNAISE SAUCE is a sauce made of clarified butter emulsified in egg yolks and white wine vinegar and flavored with herbs.

ingredients.name: Beaufort
ingredients.whatItIs: Beaufort is a firm, raw cow's milk cheese associated with the gruyère family.

ingredients.name: Beechnut
ingredients.whatItIs: Beechnuts are the small, triangular nuts produced by beech trees -genus Fagus-, particularly the American beech -Fagus grandifolia- and European beech -Fagus sylvatica-. They're edible for humans in moderate amounts, but raw beechnuts contain a compound called fagin -sometimes also referenced as related tannins- that can cause mild digestive upset or headaches if eaten in large quantities. Roasting them reduces this and improves flavor.

ingredients.name: Beetroot
ingredients.whatItIs: BEETROOT is the taproot portion of the beet plant

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.whatItIs: The bell pepper -also known as sweet pepper, pepper or capsicum /ˈkæpsɪkəm/- is a cultivar group of the species Capsicum annuum. Cultivars of the plant produce fruits in different colours, including red, yellow, orange, green, white, and purple.

ingredients.name: Biscuit
ingredients.whatItIs: A BISCUIT is a flour-based baked food product, which is typically hard, flat and unleavened.

ingredients.name: Bitter melon
ingredients.whatItIs: A balsam pear is another name for bitter melon -Momordica charantia-, a tropical vine in the gourd family. It's widely grown across Asia, Africa, the Caribbean, and South America. True to both its names, it has a pronounced bitter taste — the most bitter of any commonly eaten vegetable.

ingredients.name: Black seabream
ingredients.whatItIs: The black seabream -Spondyliosoma cantharus- is a species of Sparidae fishes. They live in northern Europe and in the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: Bleaching agent
ingredients.whatItIs: A food additive -non-flour use- used to decolourize food. Bleaching agents do not include pigments.

ingredients.name: Blend of EU and non-EU honeys
Bleu d'auvergne
ingredients.whatItIs: Bleu d'Auvergne is a French AOP blue cheese, made from cow's milk, named for its place of origin in the Auvergne region of south-central France.

ingredients.name: Bleu de Bresse
ingredients.whatItIs: Bleu de Bresse is a blue cheese made from whole milk.

ingredients.name: Bleu de gex
ingredients.whatItIs: Bleu de Gex -also Bleu du Haut-Jura or Bleu de Septmoncel- is a creamy, semi-soft blue cheese made from unpasteurized milk in the Jura region of France.

ingredients.name: Blue cheese
ingredients.whatItIs: Blue cheese or bleu cheese is cheese made with cultures of the mold Penicillium, giving it spots or veins of the mold throughout the cheese, which can vary in color through various shades of blue and green.

ingredients.name: Blue whiting
ingredients.whatItIs: The blue whiting, Micromesistius poutassou, one of the two species in the genus Micromesistius in the cod family, is common in the northeast Atlantic Ocean from Morocco to Iceland and Spitsbergen

ingredients.name: Boiled egg
ingredients.whatItIs: Boiled eggs are eggs, typically from a chicken, cooked with their shells unbroken, usually by immersion in boiling water.

ingredients.name: Bolognese sauce
ingredients.whatItIs: BOLOGNESE SAUCE is a meat-based sauce in Italian cuisine. It is customarily used to dress tagliatelle al ragù and to prepare lasagne alla bolognese.

ingredients.name: Borage
ingredients.whatItIs: Borage, also known as a starflower, is an annual herb in the flowering plant family Boraginaceae. It is native to the Mediterranean region. Borage is used as either a fresh vegetable or a dried herb.

ingredients.name: Borlotti bean
ingredients.whatItIs: The borlotti bean is a variety of common bean -Phaseolus vulgaris- first bred in Colombia as the cargamanto.

ingredients.name: Breadnut tree seeds
ingredients.whatItIs: Breadnut -also called kamansi in the Philippines, or "chataigne" in the Caribbean- produces large, spiky green fruits similar in appearance to breadfruit, but unlike the common seedless breadfruit variety, breadnut fruits are packed with edible seeds — usually 100+ per fruit. The seeds themselves are roughly the size of chestnuts or large beans. Typically boiled, roasted, or steamed before eating. After cooking, the texture is starchy and nutty, often compared to chestnuts or roasted potatoes.

ingredients.name: Brewer's yeast
ingredients.whatItIs: SACCHAROMYCES CEREVISIAE is a species of yeast. It has been instrumental to winemaking, baking, and brewing since ancient times. S. cerevisiae is used in baking; the carbon dioxide generated by the fermentation is used as a leavening agent in bread and other baked goods. Historically, this use was closely linked to the brewing industry's use of yeast, as bakers took or bought the barm or yeast-filled foam from brewing ale from the brewers -producing the barm cake-; today, brewing and baking yeast strains are somewhat different.

ingredients.name: Brie
ingredients.whatItIs: Brie is a soft cow's-milk cheese named after Brie, the French region from which it originated. It is pale in color with a slight grayish tinge under a rind of white mould.

ingredients.name: Brie de Meaux
synonyms: Brie de Meaux cheese from cow's milk
ingredients.whatItIs: Brie de Meaux is an unpasteurized brie, manufactured in the town of Meaux in the Brie region of northern France since the 8th century.

ingredients.name: Brie de Melun
synonyms: Brie de Melun cheese from cow's milk
ingredients.whatItIs: Brie de Melun is a brie made with unpasteurized milk.

ingredients.name: Brioche
ingredients.whatItIs: Brioche is a bread of French origin that is similar to a highly enriched pastry, and whose high egg and butter content give it a rich and tender crumb.

ingredients.name: Broad bean
ingredients.whatItIs: Vicia faba, also known in the culinary sense as the broad bean, fava bean, or faba bean is a species of flowering plant in the pea and bean family Fabaceae.

ingredients.name: Broad-leaved endive
ingredients.whatItIs: Escarole, or broad-leaved endive -var latifolia-, has broad, pale green leaves and is less bitter than the other varieties. Varieties or names include Batavian endive, grumolo, scarola, and scarole.

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.whatItIs: BROCCOLI is an edible green plant in the cabbage family whose large flowering head is eaten as a vegetable.

ingredients.name: Bulking agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Bulking agents are substances which contribute to the volume of a foodstuff without contributing significantly to its available energy value.

ingredients.name: Bullocks heart
ingredients.whatItIs: Native to the Caribbean and Central America, but now grown across tropical regions of South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The flesh inside is white to pale yellow, soft, and creamy, though generally considered less refined in flavor than its relatives

ingredients.name: Burbot
ingredients.whatItIs: The burbot -Lota lota- is the only gadiform -cod-like- freshwater fish.

ingredients.name: Burdock root
ingredients.whatItIs: Burdock root is an edible root vegetable and herbal remedy that comes from the burdock plant -Arctium lappa-, a large-leafed plant native to northern Asia and Europe, now grown worldwide. it's especially popular in Japanese cuisine, where it's known as gobō. It has a mildly sweet, earthy flavor and a crunchy texture.

ingredients.name: Caffeine
ingredients.whatItIs: A natural stimulant found in coffee, tea, cocoa and added to energy drinks.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides a stimulant effect and a slightly bitter taste.
ingredients.riskReason: EFSA considers single doses up to 200 mg and daily intakes up to 400 mg safe for healthy adults. Pregnant and breastfeeding women are advised to stay under 200 mg per day. Children and adolescents should have much less. Drinks with more than 150 mg per litre must be labelled as high caffeine content.
ingredients.adi: 400 mg per day for healthy adults, 200 mg per day in pregnancy (EFSA)

sources.title: EFSA (2015) scientific opinion on the safety of caffeine

ingredients.name: Cake
ingredients.whatItIs: CAKE is a form of sweet food that is usually baked. The most commonly used cake ingredients include flour, sugar, eggs, butter or oil or margarine, a liquid, and leavening agents, such as baking soda or baking powder.

ingredients.name: Camargue whole long grain black rice
Camelina oil
ingredients.whatItIs: CAMELINA sativa is a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae and is usually known in English as camelina. The crop is being researched due to its exceptionally high level -up to 45%- of omega-3 fatty acids, which is uncommon in vegetable sources.

ingredients.name: Camembert
ingredients.whatItIs: CAMEMBERT is a moist, soft, creamy, surface-ripened cow's milk cheese from Normandy, France.

ingredients.name: Cantal
ingredients.whatItIs: Cantal cheese is an uncooked firm cheese produced in the Auvergne region of central France.

ingredients.name: Cantal cheese half matured from cow's milk
Cantaloupe
ingredients.whatItIs: Cantaloupe -muskmelon, mushmelon, rockmelon, sweet melon- or spanspek -South Africa- is a variety of the Cucumis melo species in the Cucurbitaceae family.

ingredients.name: Capelin
ingredients.whatItIs: The capelin or caplin -Mallotus villosus- is a small forage fish of the smelt family found in the North Atlantic, North Pacific, and Arctic oceans. Commercialement, le capelan est utilisé comme produit alimentaire, et dans l'industrie des huiles de poisson. Sa chair a un goût agréable, ressemblant à celle du hareng. Les œufs de capelan -"masago"- sont des produits alimentaires coûteux.

ingredients.name: Capsicum oleoresin
ingredients.whatItIs: Capsicum Oleoresin is a highly concentrated capsicum extract.

ingredients.name: Caraway
ingredients.whatItIs: CARAWAY -Carum carvi-, is a biennial plant in the family Apiaceae. The fruits, usually used whole, have a pungent, anise-like flavor. Caraway is used as a spice in breads, especially rye bread. Caraway is also used in desserts, liquors, casseroles, and other foods.

ingredients.name: Carbonating agent
ingredients.whatItIs: A food additive used to provide carbonation in a food.

ingredients.name: Caribou
ingredients.whatItIs: "Caribou" is the term used in North America -Canada, Alaska- for wild populations. "Reindeer" is used in Europe and Asia, and also refers to the domesticated populations found especially in places like Scandinavia and Russia.

ingredients.name: Carissa
ingredients.whatItIs: Carissa is a tropical/subtropical fruit-bearing shrub, native to South Africa. Taste: A mix of sweet and tart, often compared to cranberry or strawberry with a slightly milky, latex-like note

ingredients.name: Carnitine
ingredients.whatItIs: Carnitine is a quaternary ammonium compound involved in metabolism in most mammals, plants and some bacteria. The body synthesizes enough carnitine from lysine side chains to keep up with the needs of energy production in the body as carnitine acts as a transporter of long-chain fatty acids into the mitochondria to be oxidized and produce energy. Food sources rich in L-carnitine are animal products such as meat, poultry, fish, and milk. Redder meats tend to have higher levels of L-carnitine. Some individuals with genetic or medical disorders -like preterm infants- cannot make enough, so this makes carnitine a conditionally essential nutrient for them.

ingredients.name: Carob bean
ingredients.whatItIs: Carob pods are mildly sweet on their own, so they are used in powdered, chip or syrup form as an ingredient in cakes and cookies, sometimes as a substitute for chocolate in recipes because of the color, texture, and taste of carob.

ingredients.name: Carob seed flour
ingredients.whatItIs: Locust bean gum is produced from the endosperm, which accounts for 42–46% of the carob seed

ingredients.name: Carrier
ingredients.whatItIs: A food additive used to dissolve, dilute, disperse or otherwise physically modify a food additive or nutrient without altering its function -and without exerting any technological effect itself- in order to facilitate its handling, application or use of the food additive or nutrient.

ingredients.name: Cayenne pepper
ingredients.whatItIs: The CAYENNE PEPPER is a type of Capsicum annuum. It is usually a moderately hot chili pepper used to flavor dishes.

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.whatItIs: Celery stalk, leaf, seed and root.
ingredients.whyUsed: Flavours stocks, soups, sauces and processed meats.
ingredients.riskReason: A declarable allergen in the EU and UK, including when present only as a flavouring.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Chard
ingredients.whatItIs: CHARD -Beta vulgaris subsp. vulgaris, Cicla-Group and Flavescens-Group- is a green leafy vegetable. Chard, like other green leafy vegetables, has highly nutritious leaves, making it a popular component of healthy diets.Fresh young chard can be used raw in salads. Mature chard leaves and stalks are typically cooked -like in pizzoccheri- or sautéed; the bitterness fades with cooking, leaving a refined flavor which is more delicate than that of cooked spinach.

ingredients.name: Chasselas
ingredients.whatItIs: Chasselas or Chasselas blanc is a wine grape variety grown in Switzerland, France, Germany, Portugal, Hungary, Romania, New Zealand and Chile.

ingredients.name: Cheddar
ingredients.whatItIs: CHEDDAR cheese is a relatively hard, off-white, sometimes sharp-tasting, natural cheese.

ingredients.name: Cherry juice from concentrated cherry juice
Chestnut
ingredients.whatItIs: The chestnuts are a group of eight or nine species of deciduous trees and shrubs in the genus Castanea. The name also refers to the edible nuts they produce. The sweet chestnut produces an edible seed, the chestnut, which has been used in cooking since ancient times.

ingredients.name: Chestnut flour
ingredients.whatItIs: Chestnuts can be dried and milled into flour, which can then be used to prepare breads, cakes, pies, pancakes, pastas, polenta, or used as thickener for stews, soups, and sauces.

ingredients.name: Chia
ingredients.whatItIs: SALVIA HISPANICA, commonly known as CHIA, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae

ingredients.name: Chia seed
ingredients.whatItIs: Chia is grown commercially for its seed, a food rich in omega-3 fatty acids since the seeds yield 25–30% extractable oil, including α-linolenic acid.

ingredients.name: Chicken cutlet
ingredients.whatItIs: Chicken Cutlet is a thin slice of meat from the leg or ribs of chicken.

ingredients.name: Chicken meat including natural chicken juices
synonyms: chicken meat and natural chicken juices

ingredients.name: Chickpea
ingredients.whatItIs: The chickpea or chick pea -Cicer arietinum- is an annual legume of the family Fabaceae, subfamily Faboideae.

ingredients.name: Chinese cabbage
ingredients.whatItIs: CHINESE CABBAGE -Brassica rapa, subspecies pekinensis and chinensis- can refer to two groups of Chinese leaf vegetables often used in Chinese cuisine: the Pekinensis Group -napa cabbage- and the Chinensis Group -bok choy-.

ingredients.name: Chlorella
ingredients.whatItIs: CHLORELLA is a genus of single-celled green algae belonging to the division Chlorophyta.

ingredients.name: Chocolate flavor filling with pieces of coconut
Chocolate-flavored paste with ground cocoa biscuits
Choline
ingredients.whatItIs: CHOLINE is a water-soluble vitamin-like essential nutrient. The US Food and Drug Administration requires that infant formula not made from cow's milk be supplemented with choline. Choline-providing dietary supplement ingredients include: choline chloride, choline bitartrate, citicoline -CDP-choline-, L-alpha-glycerophosphocholine -Alpha-GPC-, lecithin, phosphatidylcholine. Cruciferous vegetables, such as Brussels sprouts and broccoli, are good sources of choline.

ingredients.name: Choline chloride
ingredients.whatItIs: Choline chloride is an organic compound containing both quaternary ammonium salt and an alcohol. It is an important additive in feed especially for chickens where it accelerates growth. The US Food and Drug Administration requires that infant formula not made from cow's milk be supplemented with choline. Choline-providing dietary supplement ingredients include: choline chloride, choline bitartrate, citicoline -CDP-choline-, L-alpha-glycerophosphocholine -Alpha-GPC-, lecithin, phosphatidylcholine.

ingredients.name: Chorizo
synonyms: Spicy pork sausage with red pepper no precision
ingredients.whatItIs: CHORIZO or chouriço is a type of pork sausage. In Europe, chorizo is a fermented, cured, smoked sausage, which may be sliced and eaten without cooking, or added as an ingredient to add flavor to other dishes. Elsewhere, some sausages sold as chorizo may not be fermented and cured, and require cooking before eating. Spanish chorizo and Portuguese chouriço get their distinctive smokiness and deep red color from dried, smoked, red peppers.

ingredients.name: Chromic chloride
ingredients.whatItIs: CHROMIUMIII chloride -also called chromic chloride- describes any of several compounds of with the formula CrCl3 · xH2O, where x can be 0, 5, and 6. Although trivalent chromium is far less poisonous than hexavalent, chromium salts are generally considered toxic

ingredients.name: Chromium
ingredients.whatItIs: CHROMIUM is a chemical element with symbol Cr and atomic number 24.

ingredients.name: Chromium III sulfate and its hexahydrate
Churned butter
ingredients.whatItIs: CHURNED BUTTER is butter churned in a butter churn to convert cream into butter.

ingredients.name: Citrus unshiu
ingredients.whatItIs: Citrus unshiu is a semi-seedless and easy-peeling citrus species, also known as miyagawa mandarin, unshu mikan, cold hardy mandarin, satsuma mandarin, satsuma orange, naartjie, and tangerine.

ingredients.name: Clove
ingredients.whatItIs: CLOVEs are the aromatic flower buds of a tree in the family Myrtaceae, Syzygium aromaticum.

ingredients.name: Cocoa
ingredients.whatItIs: Products from the roasted and ground cacao bean.
ingredients.whyUsed: The basis of chocolate and cocoa-flavoured products.
ingredients.riskReason: No safety concern as a food. It naturally contains caffeine and theobromine, so large amounts of dark chocolate have a mild stimulant effect. Cocoa can contain cadmium, which is why some markets set limits.

sources.title: EFSA opinion on cadmium in food

ingredients.name: Cocoa powder with reduced cocoa butter content
Coconut sugar
ingredients.whatItIs: COCONUT SUGAR is a palm sugar produced from the sap of the flower bud stem of the coconut palm. It is used in savory dishes, but mainly in local desserts and cakes of the Southeast Asian region. Coconut sugar is subtly sweet almost like brown sugar but with a slight hint of caramel. The flavor and sweetness is usually similar to table sugar or brown sugar. There is no scientific evidence that coconut sugar is more nutritious or healthier than any other sweetener.

ingredients.name: Coconut water made from concentrate coconut water
Colby cheese
ingredients.whatItIs: Type of semi-hard cheese.

ingredients.name: Colour
ingredients.whatItIs: Colours are substances which add or restore colour in a food, and include natural constituents of foods and natural sources which are normally not consumed as foods as such and not normally used as characteristic ingredients of food.

ingredients.name: Common dentex
ingredients.whatItIs: The common dentex -Dentex dentex- is a species of fish in the family Sparidae. Dentex is common in the Mediterranean Sea, but also seen in the Black Sea and the Eastern Atlantic Ocean from the British Isles to Mauritania.

ingredients.name: Common sole
ingredients.whatItIs: The common sole, Dover sole, or black sole -Solea solea- is a species of flatfish in the family Soleidae.It is a largest fish in solea -fish- genus. Chefs prize Dover sole for its mild, buttery, sweet flavour and versatility, and for its ease of filleting.

ingredients.name: Comté
ingredients.whatItIs: COMTÉ -or Gruyère de Comté- is a French cheese made from unpasteurized cow's milk in the Franche-Comté region of eastern France.

ingredients.name: Concentrate
ingredients.whatItIs: CONCENTRATE is the form of substance which has had the majority of its base component -in the case of a liquid: the solvent- removed

ingredients.name: Copper
ingredients.whatItIs: COPPER is a chemical element with symbol Cu -from Latin:cuprum- and atomic number 29.

ingredients.name: Copper gluconate
ingredients.whatItIs: COPPER GLUCONATE is the copper salt of D-gluconic acid.

ingredients.name: Corinthian raisins
ingredients.whatItIs: Zante currants are small, dried, seedless grapes — despite the name, they're not actually related to fresh currants -which are berries from the Ribes genus-. Dried fruits made from the Black Corinth grape.

ingredients.name: Corn oil
ingredients.whatItIs: Corn oil -maize oil- is oil extracted from the germ of corn -maize-.

ingredients.name: Cotija cheese
ingredients.whatItIs: type of dry, firm grating cheese from Mexico.

ingredients.name: Cottonseed
ingredients.whatItIs: Cottonseed is the seed of the cotton plant -genus Gossypium-, harvested as a byproduct of cotton fiber production. After cotton bolls are picked, the fluffy fiber -lint- is separated from the seeds during a process called ginning. Each cotton boll contains several seeds embedded in the fiber. Raw cottonseed contains a natural compound called gossypol, which is toxic to humans in significant quantities. Some specialty "glandless" cotton varieties have been bred to have naturally low gossypol levels, and these are sometimes explored as a protein source -the seed kernel is fairly protein-rich-, but this isn't mainstream or widely available commercially.

ingredients.name: Flour treatment agent

ingredients.name: Foaming agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Foaming agents are substances which make it possible to form a homogenous dispersion of a gaseous phase in a liquid or solid foodstuff.

ingredients.name: Fontina
ingredients.whatItIs: Fontina is a cow's milk cheese, produced worldwide.

ingredients.name: Fontina AOP
ingredients.whatItIs: Fontina AOP is an cow's milk cheese, produced in the Aosta Valley.

ingredients.name: Fourme d'ambert
ingredients.whatItIs: Fourme d'Ambert is a semi-hard French AOC blue cheese, made from raw cow's milk from the Auvergne region of France.

ingredients.name: Fourme de Montbrison
ingredients.whatItIs: Fourme de Montbrison is a cow's-milk cheese made in the regions of Rhône-Alpes and Auvergne in southern France.

ingredients.name: Freshwater bream
ingredients.whatItIs: Bream are species of freshwater and marine fish belonging to a variety of genera.

ingredients.name: Frillice iceberg lettuce
ingredients.whatItIs: Frillice iceberg lettuce is a cross of curly endive and iceberg lettuce, with the taste and texture of iceberg and the frilly top of the curly endive.

ingredients.name: Fruit juices and purees from concentrate
Fucus
ingredients.whatItIs: Fucus is a genus of brown algae found in the intertidal zones of rocky seashores almost throughout the world.

ingredients.name: Fuki
ingredients.whatItIs: Fuki -Petasites japonicus- is a flowering plant native to Europe and parts of Asia and North America. In Japanese cuisine, fuki is a well-established vegetable and has been eaten for centuries: The leaf stalks -petioles- are the main edible part — boiled, then peeled and used in simmered dishes -nimono-, stir-fries, or as a side dish; The flower buds -fuki no tō- are a beloved spring delicacy, eaten tempura-fried or as a miso paste — they have a pleasant, slightly bitter taste.

ingredients.name: Gai lan
ingredients.whatItIs: Chinese broccoli -also called gai lan or kai lan, 芥蓝- is actually a distinct vegetable from regular broccoli, though they're related. Both belong to the Brassica oleracea species and the broader cabbage family. Gai lan has long, thick green stalks with flat, broad leaves and small, scattered flower buds. Western broccoli has a large, compact floret head on a thick stalk. It's slightly more bitter and robust than regular broccoli, with an earthy, slightly peppery flavor.

ingredients.name: Garofa nectarine
ingredients.whatItIs: Yellow-fleshed early season nectarine variety.

ingredients.name: Gelatine
ingredients.whatItIs: A protein obtained by boiling animal skin, bone and connective tissue, usually from pigs or cattle.
ingredients.whyUsed: Sets sweets, marshmallows, mousses, yoghurts and capsule shells.
ingredients.riskReason: No safety concern as a food. It is an animal product, so it is unsuitable for vegans and vegetarians, and its acceptability in halal and kosher diets depends entirely on the source animal and certification.

sources.title: EFSA opinion on the safety of collagen and gelatine

ingredients.name: Gelling agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Gelling agents are substances which give a foodstuff texture through formation of a gel.

ingredients.name: Gherkin
ingredients.whatItIs: GHERKIN can refer to either a pickled small cucumber -esp. in Ireland and the UK- or an unpickled small cucumber

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.whatItIs: GINGER -Zingiber officinale- is a flowering plant whose rhizome, ginger root or simply ginger, is widely used as a spice or a folk medicine

ingredients.name: Gingerbread
ingredients.whatItIs: GINGERBREAD refers to a broad category of baked goods, typically flavored with ginger, cloves, nutmeg or cinnamon and sweetened with honey, sugar or molasses.

ingredients.name: Glasswort
ingredients.whatItIs: Salicornia is a genus of succulent, halophyte -salt tolerant- flowering plants in the family Amaranthaceae that grow in salt marshes, on beaches, and among mangroves. The main European species is often eaten and the main North American species is occasionally sold in grocery stores or appears on restaurant menus, usually as 'sea beans' or samphire greens or sea asparagus.

ingredients.name: Glazing agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Glazing agents -including lubricants- are substances which, when applied to the external surface of a foodstuff, impart a shiny appearance or provide a protective coating.

ingredients.name: Glucose Syrup
ingredients.whatItIs: A sweet syrup made by breaking down starch, usually from maize or wheat.
ingredients.whyUsed: Sweetens, controls crystallisation and adds body to sweets, ice cream and baked goods.
ingredients.riskReason: Counts as free sugars, which the WHO recommends keeping below 10 percent of daily energy intake. It is rapidly absorbed and raises blood glucose quickly.

sources.title: WHO guideline on sugars intake for adults and children

ingredients.name: Glycerol monostearate
ingredients.whatItIs: GLYCEROL MONOSTEARATE, commonly known as GMS, is a monoglyceride commonly used as an emulsifier in foods. GMS is a food additive used as a thickening, emulsifying, anticaking, and preservative agent; an emulsifying agent for oils, waxes, and solvents; a protective coating for hygroscopic powders; a solidifier and control release agent in pharmaceuticals; and a resin lubricant.

ingredients.name: Goat meat
ingredients.whatItIs: GOAT MEAT or goat's meat is the meat of the domestic goat -Capra aegagrus hircus-. Goat meat is savory and less sweet than beef[9] but slightly sweeter than lamb. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, such as being stewed, curried, baked, grilled, barbecued, minced, canned, fried, or made into sausage. Goat jerky is also another popular variety.

ingredients.name: Goat milk
ingredients.whatItIs: Goat milk is the milk of domestic goats.

ingredients.name: Golden chanterelle
ingredients.whatItIs: CANTHARELLUS CIBARIUS is a species of golden chanterelle mushroom in the genus Cantharellus.

ingredients.name: Gorgonzola
ingredients.whatItIs: GORGONZOLA is a veined Italian blue cheese, made from unskimmed cow's milk.

ingredients.name: Gouda
ingredients.whatItIs: GOUDA is a mild, yellow cheese made from cow's milk.

ingredients.name: Grana Padano
synonyms: Grana Padano cheese from cow's milk
ingredients.whatItIs: GRANA PADANO is a hard, slow-ripened, semi-fat, cow's-milk cheese from Italy.

ingredients.name: Grape
ingredients.whatItIs: A grape is a fruit, botanically a berry, of the deciduous woody vines of the flowering plant genus Vitis.

ingredients.name: Grape juice
ingredients.whatItIs: Grape juice is obtained from crushing and blending grapes into a liquid.

ingredients.name: Grape juice from concentrate
ingredients.whatItIs: This is a compound product made of concentrate grape juice and water.

ingredients.name: Grape seed oil
ingredients.whatItIs: GRAPE SEED OIL -also called grapeseed oil or grape oil- is pressed from the seeds of grapes, and is thus an abundant by-product of winemaking.

synonyms: Emmental cheese grated from cow's milk

ingredients.name: Greenland halibut
ingredients.whatItIs: The Greenland halibut or Greenland turbot -Reinhardtius hippoglossoides- belongs to the family Pleuronectidae.

ingredients.name: Grouper
ingredients.whatItIs: Groupers are fish of any of a number of genera in the subfamily Epinephelinae of the family Serranidae, in the order Perciformes.

ingredients.name: Gruyère
ingredients.whatItIs: Gruyere is a hard cheese mad from cow milk. It originates either from Switzerland or France.

ingredients.name: Gruyère AOP
ingredients.whatItIs: GRUYÈRE is a hard yellow cheese that originated in the cantons of Fribourg, Vaud, Neuchâtel, Jura, and Bern in Switzerland.

ingredients.name: Half-old Mimolette
synonyms: half-old Mimolette cheese from cow's milk

ingredients.name: Harissa
ingredients.whatItIs: HARISSA is a Tunisian hot chili pepper paste, the main ingredients of which are roasted red peppers, Baklouti pepper, serrano peppers, and other hot chili peppers, spices and herbs such as garlic paste, coriander seed, saffron, rose, or caraway, as well as some vegetable or olive oil to carry the oil-soluble flavors.

ingredients.name: Havarti
ingredients.whatItIs: semisoft Danish cow's milk cheese.

ingredients.name: Hazelnut paste with pieces of biscuits
Herring
ingredients.whatItIs: A type of small, oily fish of the genus Clupea, often used as food.

ingredients.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
ingredients.whatItIs: A liquid sweetener made from corn starch, with fructose and glucose in varying proportions.
ingredients.whyUsed: Cheap sweetener for soft drinks, sauces, cereals, breads and confectionery.
ingredients.riskReason: Metabolically similar to table sugar, so the concern is quantity rather than the ingredient being uniquely harmful. It is a major contributor of free sugars, and the WHO recommends limiting free sugars to under 10 percent of daily energy, ideally under 5 percent.

sources.title: WHO guideline on sugars intake for adults and children

ingredients.name: Hickorynut
ingredients.whatItIs: A hickory nut is the edible nut produced by trees in the genus Carya — the same genus that includes pecans. They're native mostly to North America, with a few species in Asia. Encased in a thick, husk-like outer covering that splits open -fully or partially, depending on species- when ripe, revealing a hard shell. Inside that shell is the actual nutmeat. Flavor varies a lot by species — some, like shagbark hickory, are sweet and rich -similar to a pecan, which makes sense given the family connection-, while others, like pignut hickory, can be bitter or astringent.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.whatItIs: A sweet syrup produced by bees.
ingredients.whyUsed: Sweetens and flavours cereals, drinks, baked goods and sauces.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritionally close to other sugars, so it counts toward free sugars. Importantly, honey must not be given to infants under 12 months because of the risk of infant botulism.

sources.title: NHS guidance: foods to avoid giving babies

ingredients.name: Honjozo
ingredients.whatItIs: Honjōzō -本醸造, 'genuine fermented'-: Contains 100% genuine fermented product

ingredients.name: Horned melon
ingredients.whatItIs: The horned melon -kiwano- is a tropical fruit native to sub-Saharan Africa, though it's now grown in other warm regions like New Zealand, Australia, and California. The flavor is mild and refreshing — often described as a blend of cucumber, banana, and lime, with a slightly tart note.

ingredients.name: Horse mackerel
ingredients.whatItIs: Horse mackerel is a vague vernacular term for a range of species of fish throughout the English-speaking world.

ingredients.name: Horseradish
ingredients.whatItIs: HORSERADISH -Armoracia rusticana, syn. Cochlearia armoracia- is a perennial plant of the family Brassicaceae. The intact horseradish root has hardly any aroma. When cut or grated enzymes from the now-broken plant cells break down sinigrin -a glucosinolate- to produce allyl isothiocyanate -mustard oil-, which irritates the mucous membranes of the sinuses and eyes. Grated mash should be used immediately or preserved in vinegar for best flavor.

Hulled barley
ingredients.whatItIs: Hulled barley is a whole grain barley with only the inedible outer shell removed.

ingredients.name: Humectant
ingredients.whatItIs: Humectants are substances which prevent foods from drying out by counteracting the effect of an atmosphere having a low degree of humidity, or promote the dissolution of a powder in an aqueous medium.

ingredients.name: Hyacinth bean
ingredients.whatItIs: Hyacinth beans -Lablab purpureus, also called lablab beans, dolichos beans, or Egyptian beans- are a fast-growing climbing vine grown both as an ornamental plant and a food crop. The young, immature pods can be cooked and eaten like green beans. However, the mature beans and pods contain cyanogenic glycosides and must be thoroughly cooked -usually boiled with water changes- before eating — they're toxic raw or undercooked. In parts of Africa and Asia, they're a significant food crop and protein source when properly prepared.

Hydrogenated soybean shortening for cakes and frostings
Ice cream
ingredients.whatItIs: ICE CREAM is a sweetened frozen food typically eaten as a snack or dessert. It may be made from dairy milk or cream, or soy, cashew, coconut or almondmilk, and is flavored with a sweetener, either sugar or an alternative, and any spice, such as cocoa or vanilla. Colourings are usually added, in addition to stabilizers.

ingredients.name: Illipe oil
ingredients.whatItIs: ILLIPE butter is a vegetable fat from the nut of the Shorea stenoptera tree.

ingredients.name: Imleria

ingredients.name: Indian squid

Inosine monophosphate
ingredients.whatItIs: INOSINE MONOPHOSPHATE -IMP- is a nucleoside monophosphate. Widely used as a flavor enhancer, it is typically obtained from chicken byproducts or other meat industry waste.

ingredients.name: Inositol
ingredients.whatItIs: INOSITOL is a carbocyclic sugar that is abundant in brain and other mammalian tissues, mediates cell signal transduction and participates in osmoregulation. It is a sugar alcohol with half the sweetness of table sugar. It is made naturally in humans from glucose. A human kidney will produce around two grams each day. Foods containing the highest concentrations of inositol include fruits, beans, grains, and nuts.

ingredients.name: Instant coffee
ingredients.whatItIs: INSTANT COFFEE is a beverage derived from brewed coffee beans that enables people to quickly prepare hot coffee by adding hot water or milk to the powder or crystals and stirring

ingredients.name: Iodine
ingredients.whatItIs: IODINE is a chemical element with symbol I and atomic number 53.

ingredients.name: Iron
ingredients.whatItIs: IRON is a chemical element with symbol Fe -from Latin:ferrum- and atomic number 26. Iron is pervasive, but particularly rich sources of dietary iron include red meat, oysters, lentils, beans, poultry, fish, leaf vegetables, watercress, tofu, chickpeas, black-eyed peas, and blackstrap molasses. Iron provided by dietary supplements is often found as ironII fumarate, although iron-II- sulfate is cheaper and is absorbed equally well.

ingredients.name: Iron fumarate
ingredients.whatItIs: IRONII GLUCONATE, or ferrous gluconate,[1] is a black compound often used as an iron supplement. It is the iron-II- salt of gluconic acid.

ingredients.name: Java plum
ingredients.whatItIs: Java plum -Syzygium cumini- is a tropical evergreen tree in the myrtle family -Myrtaceae-, making it more closely related to cloves and eucalyptus than to actual plums.

ingredients.name: Jujube
ingredients.whatItIs: Jujube -also called Chinese date or red date- is a small fruit from the Ziziphus jujuba tree, native to China but now grown throughout Asia, the Middle East, and parts of Europe and America. Fresh jujubes taste crisp and mildly sweet, similar to an apple.

ingredients.name: Kamaboko
ingredients.whatItIs: type of cured surimi, a processed seafood product common in Japanese cuisine

ingredients.name: Kanzuri
ingredients.whatItIs: Japanese fermented chili paste manufactured in Niigata Prefecture

ingredients.name: Katsuobushi
ingredients.whatItIs: simmered, smoked and fermented skipjack tuna

ingredients.name: Kirsch
ingredients.whatItIs: A kirschwasser or kirsch is a clear, colorless fruit brandy traditionally made from double distillation of morello cherries, a dark-colored cultivar of the sour cherry.

ingredients.name: Kiwifruit
ingredients.whatItIs: KIWIFRUIT -often abbreviated as KIWI-, or Chinese gooseberry is the edible berry of several species of woody vines in the genus Actinidia.

ingredients.name: Kombu
ingredients.whatItIs: KOMBU -from Japanese: 昆布, translit. konbu- is edible kelp from mostly the family Laminariaceae and is widely eaten in East Asia. There are about eighteen edible species in Laminariaceae and most of them, but not all, are called kombu.

ingredients.name: Kosher salt
ingredients.whatItIs: Kosher salt or kitchen salt[1] is edible salt with a larger grain size than typical table salt and without common additives such as iodine.

ingredients.name: L-carnitine
ingredients.whatItIs: L-CARNITINE is the left isomer of carnitine, a quaternary ammonium compound involved in metabolism in most mammals, plants and some bacteria. The body synthesizes enough carnitine from lysine side chains to keep up with the needs of energy production in the body as carnitine acts as a transporter of long-chain fatty acids into the mitochondria to be oxidized and produce energy. Food sources rich in L-carnitine are animal products such as meat, poultry, fish, and milk. Redder meats tend to have higher levels of L-carnitine. Some individuals with genetic or medical disorders -like preterm infants- cannot make enough, so this makes carnitine a conditionally essential nutrient for them.

ingredients.name: Langres
ingredients.whatItIs: Langres is a French cheese from the plateau of Langres in the region of Champagne-Ardenne.

Lard and vegetable oil industrial shortening
Leccinum
ingredients.whatItIs: LECCINUM is a genus of mushrooms from the Boletaceae family

ingredients.name: Legume
ingredients.whatItIs: A LEGUME is a plant in the family Fabaceae -or Leguminosae-, or the fruit or seed of such a plant -also called a pulse-. Legumes are grown agriculturally, primarily for human consumption. Grain legumes include beans, lentils, lupins, peas, and peanuts.

ingredients.name: Lemon peel
ingredients.whatItIs: The skin or outer layer of a lemon.

ingredients.name: Lemon zest
ingredients.whatItIs: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, removed through a zester.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.whatItIs: The lentil -Lens culinaris or Lens esculenta- is an edible legume. Lentils are consumed in many ways. They can be eaten soaked, germinated, boiled, fried and baked.

ingredients.name: Light syrup
ingredients.whatItIs: Light syrup is similar to Golden Syrup, but is made slightly differently and is a bit thinner.

ingredients.name: Lightly salted butter
ingredients.whatItIs: BEURRE DEMI-SEL is a butter with a salt percentage between 0‚5 % and 3 %

ingredients.name: Lima bean
ingredients.whatItIs: Phaseolus lunatus, commonly known as the LIMA BEAN, butter bean, sieva bean, Double Bean or Madagascar bean, is a legume grown for its edible seeds or beans

ingredients.name: Ling
ingredients.whatItIs: Molva est un genre de poissons appelés lingues, élingues ou juliennes.

ingredients.name: Liquorice
ingredients.whatItIs: LIQUORICE or licorice is the root of Glycyrrhiza glabra from which a sweet flavour can be extracted.

ingredients.name: Livarot
ingredients.whatItIs: Livarot is a French cheese of the Normandy region, originating in the commune of Livarot.

ingredients.name: Lotus seed
ingredients.whatItIs: Lotus seeds are the edible seeds of the lotus plant -Nelumbo nucifera-, an aquatic plant grown widely across Asia, particularly in China, India, and Southeast Asia. Fresh seeds have a mild, slightly sweet, nutty flavor and a crisp texture, often eaten raw or lightly cooked. Dried seeds are used in soups, congee, and herbal tonics

ingredients.name: Lupin
ingredients.whatItIs: A legume whose flour is used in some baked goods and pasta.
ingredients.whyUsed: Adds protein and colour to breads, pastries and gluten-free products.
ingredients.riskReason: A declarable allergen in the EU and UK. People allergic to peanuts have an increased chance of also reacting to lupin.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Lupin bean
ingredients.whatItIs: Lupin or lupini beans are the yellow legume seeds of the genus Lupinus. They are traditionally eaten as a pickled snack food. The lupin is devoid of starch, which is very unusual for a species of edible bean. Lupin allergy may cause life-threatening anaphylaxis in sensitive individuals. Only "sweet" varieties of lupin are used for human food

ingredients.name: Lychee
ingredients.whatItIs: LYCHEE is the sole member of the genus Litchi in the soapberry family, Sapindaceae.

ingredients.name: Maasdam
ingredients.whatItIs: MAASDAM cheese is a Swiss-style Dutch cheese.

ingredients.name: Mackerel
ingredients.whatItIs: Mackerel is a common name applied to a number of different species of pelagic fish, mostly from the family Scombridae.

ingredients.name: Magnesium
ingredients.whatItIs: MAGNESIUM is a chemical element with symbol Mg and atomic number 12. The important interaction between phosphate and magnesium ions makes magnesium essential to the basic nucleic acid chemistry of all cells of all known living organisms. Spices, nuts, cereals, cocoa and vegetables are rich sources of magnesium. Green leafy vegetables such as spinach are also rich in magnesium.

ingredients.name: Maize / Corn
ingredients.whatItIs: A cereal grain, naturally gluten free.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used as flour, starch, grits and syrup across an enormous range of foods.
ingredients.riskReason: A staple food with no safety concern as an ingredient.

Maltodextrin
ingredients.whatItIs: A lightly sweet carbohydrate powder made from starch.
ingredients.whyUsed: Bulks, thickens and carries flavours in powdered drinks, sauces, snacks and sports products.
ingredients.riskReason: Safe as a food, but it is a rapidly digested carbohydrate with a high glycaemic index, so it can raise blood glucose quickly. Wheat-derived maltodextrin is normally processed enough to be gluten free, but the source should be checked in a coeliac diet.

sources.title: US FDA: substances added to food inventory

ingredients.name: Maltose
ingredients.whatItIs: MALTOSE, also known as maltobiose or malt sugar, is a disaccharide formed from two units of glucose joined. Maltose is a component of malt, a substance which is obtained in the process of allowing grain to soften in water and germinate. It is also present in highly variable quantities in partially hydrolysed starch products like maltodextrin, corn syrup and acid-thinned starch. In humans, maltose is broken down by various maltase enzymes, providing two glucose molecules which can be further processed: either broken down to provide energy, or stored as glycogen. The lack of the sucrase-isomaltase enzyme in humans causes sucrose intolerance.

ingredients.name: Mamey sapote
ingredients.whatItIs: Mamey Sapote -Pouteria sapota-. It has a rough brown skin like a football, and vibrant salmon-pink to reddish flesh with a rich, creamy flavor often compared to a mix of sweet potato, pumpkin, and almond. Widely used in smoothies and ice cream in Latin America and the Caribbean.

ingredients.name: Mammy apple
ingredients.whatItIs: A mammy apple is a tropical fruit native to the Caribbean and tropical Americas. Despite the name, they are actually classified as a berry, not a true apple. The flesh is intensely aromatic and deep orange, with a flavour similar to an apricot or raspberry.

ingredients.name: Manganese
ingredients.whatItIs: MANGANESE is a chemical element with symbol Mn and atomic number 25. Manganese is an essential human dietary element. It is present as a coenzyme in several biological processes, which include macronutrient metabolism, bone formation, free radical defense systems.

ingredients.name: Manganese sulfate
ingredients.whatItIs: MANGANESE SULFATE usually refers to the inorganic compound with the formula MnSO4·H2O. Magnesium sulfate is used as a brewing salt in making beer. It may also be used as a coagulant for making tofu.

ingredients.name: Margarine
ingredients.whatItIs: MARGARINE is a spread used for flavoring, baking, and cooking. Margarine is made mainly of refined vegetable oil and water.

ingredients.name: Marjoram
ingredients.whatItIs: Marjoram -Origanum majorana- is a somewhat cold-sensitive perennial herb or undershrub with sweet pine and citrus flavors.

ingredients.name: Maroilles
ingredients.whatItIs: Maroilles is a cow's-milk cheese made in the regions of Picardy and Nord-Pas-de-Calais in northern France.

ingredients.name: Marzipan
ingredients.whatItIs: MARZIPAN is a confection consisting primarily of sugar or honey and almond meal -ground almonds-, sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract.

ingredients.name: Mate
ingredients.whatItIs: Mate is a traditional South American caffeine-rich infused drink. It is prepared by steeping dried leaves of yerba mate in hot water and is served with a metal straw from a shared hollow calabash gourd

ingredients.name: Mayonnaise
ingredients.whatItIs: MAYONNAISE, informally mayo, is a thick cold sauce or dressing usually used in sandwiches and composed salads or on chips. It is a stable emulsion of oil, egg yolk, and acid, either vinegar or lemon juice.

ingredients.name: Meringue
ingredients.whatItIs: Meringue is a type of dessert or candy, traditionally made from whipped egg whites and sugar.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.whatItIs: Dairy milk and the ingredients derived from it.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides protein, fat, sweetness and texture across chocolate, baked goods, sauces and desserts.
ingredients.riskReason: A nutritious staple. Milk is one of the 14 allergens that must always be declared, and lactose intolerance is common worldwide.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Millet

ingredients.name: Mimolette
ingredients.whatItIs: Mimolette is a cheese traditionally produced around the city of Lille, France.

ingredients.name: Miso
ingredients.whatItIs: MISO is a traditional Japanese seasoning produced by fermenting soybeans with salt and kōji -the fungus Aspergillus oryzae- and sometimes rice, barley, seaweed or other ingredients.

ingredients.name: Molluscs

ingredients.whyUsed: Used in seafood dishes and in sauces such as oyster sauce.

Mono- and diglycerides of vegetable fatty acids
Monterey Jack
ingredients.whatItIs: MONTEREY JACK, sometimes shortened to Jack, is an American white, semi-hard cheese made using cow's milk. It is noted for its mild flavor and slight sweetness.

ingredients.name: Morbier
ingredients.whatItIs: Morbier is an AOP semi-soft cows' milk cheese of France.

ingredients.name: Moth bean

ingredients.name: Mozzarella

ingredients.name: Mustard cabbage
ingredients.whatItIs: Mustard Cabbage -also called gai choy or Chinese mustard- is a leafy green vegetable common in Asian cuisine. Large, crinkled or smooth leaves, often with a pale green or yellowish color; can look somewhat like bok choy or napa cabbage. Distinctly pungent and slightly bitter, with a mustardy kick that mellows when cooked.

ingredients.name: Nance
ingredients.whatItIs: Nance is a small tropical fruit native to Central America, the Caribbean, and parts of South America. Small, round, yellow to orange berries, about 1–2 cm in diameter, growing in clusters. It has a very distinctive, pungent aroma and a flavor that's a unique mix of sweet, sour, and slightly cheesy or fermented.

ingredients.name: Naranjilla
ingredients.whatItIs: Naranjilla is a tropical fruit native to South America, mainly grown in Ecuador, Colombia, and Peru. Small to medium round fruit, about the size of a golf ball with bright orange skin covered in fine, removable fuzz. The flavor is very distinctive — a unique mix of tart, citrusy, and tropical, often described as a cross between pineapple, lime, and rhubarb.

Natural Flavouring
ingredients.whatItIs: A blend of aroma compounds obtained from natural sources. The exact composition is not usually disclosed.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides taste and aroma across almost every processed food category.
ingredients.riskReason: Flavourings are evaluated and authorised in the EU, so the components are assessed for safety. The reason for caution is transparency rather than toxicity: the label does not tell you what is in the blend, which is a problem if you have an allergy or follow a strict diet.

ingredients.name: Neapolitan wafer

ingredients.name: Neufchâtel

ingredients.name: Nile perch
ingredients.whatItIs: The Nile perch -Lates niloticus-, also known as the African snook, Goliath perch, Giant lates or the Victoria perch, is a species of freshwater fish in family Latidae of order Perciformes. It is widespread throughout much of the Afrotropical realm.

ingredients.name: Nutmeg

ingredients.name: Oats

ingredients.whyUsed: Used in breakfast cereals, breads, biscuits, bars and oat drinks.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritious, with beta-glucan recognised for helping maintain normal blood cholesterol. Oats are a declarable cereal containing gluten in the EU, and are frequently cross-contaminated with wheat unless certified gluten free.

ingredients.riskReason: One of the better-studied dietary fats, central to Mediterranean dietary patterns associated with cardiovascular benefit.

ingredients.name: Pak choi
ingredients.whatItIs: Bok choy, pak choi or pok choi -Chinese:上海青; pinyin:Shànghǎi qīng; literally:"Shanghai Green"; Brassica rapa subsp. chinensis- is a type of Chinese cabbage.

ingredients.name: Palm Oil
ingredients.whatItIs: An edible oil from the fruit of the oil palm, semi-solid at room temperature.
ingredients.whyUsed: Very widely used in spreads, baked goods, confectionery, instant noodles and frying fats.
ingredients.riskReason: High in saturated fat, which raises LDL cholesterol when it replaces unsaturated fats. Separately, refining palm oil at high temperatures can generate glycidyl esters and 3-MCPD, contaminants EFSA has flagged, and which industry has since worked to reduce. Palm oil cultivation is also a major driver of deforestation.

sources.title: EFSA: risks for human health related to glycidyl esters and 3-MCPD in palm oil

Parmigiano reggiano
ingredients.whatItIs: PARMIGIANO-REGGIANO is an Italian hard, granular cheese.

ingredients.name: Parsley

Partially Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil
ingredients.whatItIs: Vegetable oil partly hardened by adding hydrogen, which creates industrial trans fatty acids.
ingredients.whyUsed: Historically used to make cheap solid fats for baking, frying and margarine with a long shelf life.
ingredients.riskReason: Industrially produced trans fat raises LDL cholesterol and lowers HDL cholesterol, and is linked to increased coronary heart disease risk. The WHO has called for global elimination, the FDA removed its 'generally recognised as safe' status, and the EU limits industrial trans fat to 2 g per 100 g of fat.

sources.title: WHO: countdown to a trans fat free world
US FDA final determination on partially hydrogenated oils

ingredients.name: Patagonian squid
ingredients.whatItIs: Doryteuthis gahi, also known as the Patagonian squid and locally as calamar, is a small-sized squid belonging to the family Loliginidae.

ingredients.name: Pea
ingredients.whatItIs: Peas are a good example of how the same plant can fall into different categories depending on how it's harvested and used. Fresh peas -green peas, snap peas, snow peas- are harvested young and eaten fresh, in or out of the pod. they are classified as a vegetable, not a pulse. Dried peas are the same plant, but the peas are left to mature and dry on the vine before harvesting. This is what counts as a pulse.

ingredients.name: Peach
ingredients.whatItIs: The peach -Prunus persica- is a deciduous tree native to the region of Northwest China. It bears edible juicy fruits with various characteristics, most called peaches and others -the glossy-skinned varieties-, nectarines.

ingredients.name: Peanut
ingredients.whatItIs: A legume, botanically distinct from tree nuts.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used in confectionery, snacks, sauces and baked goods.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritious, but one of the most significant food allergens, capable of causing severe and rapid anaphylaxis in sensitised people. Must always be declared.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Pear
ingredients.whatItIs: The PEAR is any of several tree and shrub species of genus Pyrus, in the family Rosaceae. Note this refers to the tree and not the fruit

ingredients.name: Peruvian scallop
ingredients.whatItIs: Argopecten purpuratus, common names the Peruvian scallop, is an edible species of saltwater clam, a scallop.

ingredients.name: Pesto
ingredients.whatItIs: PESTO is a sauce originating in Genoa, Italy. It traditionally consists of crushed garlic, European pine nuts, coarse salt, basil leaves, hard cheese, all blended with olive oil.

ingredients.name: Petit-Beurre
ingredients.whatItIs: The "PETIT BEURRE", or "Véritable Petit Beurre", also known under the initials "VPB", is a kind of shortbread from Nantes, that is best known in France. It is the Petit Beurre of the LU society, which has become a success worldwide.

ingredients.name: Picodon
ingredients.whatItIs: Picodon is a goats-milk cheese made in the region around the Rhône in southern France.

ingredients.name: Pilinut
ingredients.whatItIs: A pili nut -Canarium ovatum- is a tropical tree nut native to the Philippines, particularly grown in the Bicol region. The nut has a rich, buttery flavor and texture, often compared to a cross between an almond and a macadamia nut — but generally considered even richer and more delicate. They're eaten raw, roasted, or candied, and are also used in pastries, pesto-style sauces, and as a snack food. In the Philippines they're a popular treat, especially when sugar-coated.

ingredients.name: Pink peppercorn
ingredients.whatItIs: A PINK PEPPERCORN is a dried berry of the shrub Schinus molle, commonly known as the Peruvian peppertree. Although a peppercorn is the dried fruit of a plant from the genus Piper, pink peppercorns came to be called such because they resemble peppercorns, and because they, too, have a peppery flavour. As they are members of the cashew family, they may cause allergic reactions including anaphylaxis for persons with a tree nut allergy.

ingredients.name: Pitanga
ingredients.whatItIs: Pitanga is a tropical fruit native to South America. The fruit is a berry with a persistent calyx up to 4 cm in diameter and eight clearly visible ribs. Its color changes from green to orange and purple as it matures. The flavor is unique — peppery and fruity, and quite complex

ingredients.name: Pont l'evêque

ingredients.name: Poppyseed

ingredients.name: Pork belly

ingredients.name: Pork fillet

ingredients.name: Pork loin
ingredients.whatItIs: Pork loin is a cut of meat from a pig, created from the tissue along the dorsal side of the rib cage.

ingredients.name: Pot barley
ingredients.whatItIs: Pot barley is barley that has been processed to remove its fibrous outer hull but has not been polished.

ingredients.name: Potassium
ingredients.whatItIs: POTASSIUM is a chemical element with symbol K -from Neo-Latin kalium- and atomic number 19. Potassium ions are vital for the functioning of all living cells. The transfer of potassium ions across nerve cell membranes is necessary for normal nerve transmission; potassium deficiency and excess can each result in numerous signs and symptoms, including an abnormal heart rhythm and various electrocardiographic abnormalities. Fresh fruits and vegetables are good dietary sources of potassium.

ingredients.name: Potassium iodide
ingredients.whatItIs: POTASSIUM IODIDE is a chemical compound, medication, and dietary supplement. As a medication it is used to treat hyperthyroidism, in radiation emergencies, and to protect the thyroid gland when certain types of radiopharmaceuticals are used.

ingredients.name: Potassium Bromate
ingredients.whatItIs: A flour oxidising agent.
ingredients.whyUsed: Strengthens dough and improves bread volume. Still permitted in some countries.
ingredients.riskReason: Classified by the IARC as possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B). Banned as a food additive in the EU, the UK, Canada, Brazil, China and India, among others.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.whatItIs: A starchy tuber.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used whole, dried, and as starch for thickening.
ingredients.riskReason: A staple food. Note that frying or roasting potato at high temperatures forms acrylamide, which is why cooking guidance advises golden rather than dark browning.

sources.title: EFSA opinion on acrylamide in food

ingredients.name: Poulsard
ingredients.whatItIs: Poulsard -also Ploussard- is a red French wine grape variety from the Jura wine region.

ingredients.name: Poultry
ingredients.whatItIs: Poultry are domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, their meat or their feathers.

ingredients.name: Pouting
ingredients.whatItIs: Trisopterus luscus -bib, pout whiting, pout or most commonly pouting- is a seafish belonging to the cod family -Gadidae-.

ingredients.name: Pošip

ingredients.name: Prickly pear

ingredients.name: Propellent gas

ingredients.name: Protein

ingredients.name: Prune
ingredients.whatItIs: A prune is a dried plum of any cultivar, mostly Prunus domestica or European Plum.

ingredients.name: Psyllium
ingredients.whatItIs: Psyllium, or ispaghula, is the common name used for several members of the plant genus Plantago whose seeds are used commercially for the production of mucilage. It can be used for the fibres or as infusion.

ingredients.name: Pulse
ingredients.whatItIs: pulse = just the dry, harvested seed of specific legume crops. The UN Food and Agriculture Organization -FAO- recognizes 11 categories of pulses: Dry beans — includes kidney beans, navy beans, pinto beans, black beans, lima beans, mung beans, adzuki beans; Dry broad beans — fava beans, horse beans, broad beans -in dried form-; Dry peas — includes split peas, whole dried peas -green or yellow-; Chickpeas — also called garbanzo beans; Dry cowpeas — black-eyed peas, blackeye beans; Pigeon peas — also called Congo beans or gandules; Lentils — includes red, green, brown, black -beluga-, French -Puy-; Bambara beans — also called Bambara groundnuts -earth peas-; Vetches — common vetch; Lupins — lupin beans -also called lupini beans-; Minor pulses — a catch-all for less common ones, such as lablab, jack beans, winged beans, yam beans

ingredients.name: Quenelle
ingredients.whatItIs: A quenelle is a mixture of creamed fish or meat, sometimes combined with breadcrumbs, with a light egg binding, formed into an egg-like shape, and then cooked.

ingredients.name: Quince

ingredients.name: Quorn mushroom product

ingredients.name: Raclette
ingredients.whatItIs: RACLETTE is a semi-hard cow's milk cheese.

ingredients.name: Rainbow trout
ingredients.whatItIs: The rainbow trout -Oncorhynchus mykiss- is a trout and species of salmonid native to cold-water tributaries of the Pacific Ocean in Asia and North America.

ingredients.name: Raisin
ingredients.whatItIs: A RAISIN is a dried grape.

ingredients.name: Raising agent
ingredients.whatItIs: Raising agents are substances or combinations of substances which liberate gas and thereby increase the volume of a dough or a batter.

ingredients.name: Rapeseed Oil
ingredients.whatItIs: An oil pressed from rapeseed, also sold as canola oil.
ingredients.whyUsed: General cooking, frying, spreads and mayonnaise.
ingredients.riskReason: Low in saturated fat and a source of omega-3 alpha-linolenic acid. Food-grade rapeseed oil is bred to contain very little erucic acid.

ingredients.name: Raw emu oyster
ingredients.whatItIs: The Emu Oyster is an egg-shaped fillet found along the backbone just above the thigh, with a thick sinew layer running through the middle. It's typically sliced thin for stir-fries or cooked low and slow until tender.

Raw spanish peanut
ingredients.whatItIs: Spanish peanuts are a specific variety of peanut, distinct from the more common runner or Virginia types you'd find as standard roasted peanuts or in most peanut butter. Grown mainly in Oklahoma and Texas in the US, though the name comes from their origin.

ingredients.name: Reblochon

ingredients.name: Red cabbage
ingredients.whatItIs: The red cabbage -purple-leaved varieties of Brassica oleracea Capitata Group- is a kind of cabbage, also known as purple cabbage, red kraut, or blue kraut after preparation.

ingredients.name: Red kuri squash

ingredients.name: Red plum

ingredients.whatItIs: RED WINE is a type of wine made from dark-colored -black- grape varieties. The actual color of the wine can range from intense violet, typical of young wines, through to brick red for mature wines and brown for older red wines. The juice from most purple grapes is greenish-white, the red color coming from anthocyan pigments present in the skin of the grape

ingredients.name: Refined olive oil
ingredients.whatItIs: Refined olive oil is virgin oil refined using charcoal and other chemical and physical filters, methods which do not alter the glyceridic structure.

ingredients.name: Reindeer
ingredients.whatItIs: "Reindeer" is used in Europe and Asia, and also refers to the domesticated populations found especially in places like Scandinavia and Russia. "Caribou" is the term used in North America -Canada, Alaska- for wild populations.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.whatItIs: A cereal grain, naturally gluten free.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used whole, as flour and as starch in a wide range of foods and gluten-free products.
ingredients.riskReason: A staple food. Rice takes up more inorganic arsenic from soil than most crops, which is why some authorities advise against rice drinks as a milk substitute for young children.

ingredients.name: Rice bran oil
ingredients.whatItIs: RICE BRAN OIL is the oil extracted from the hard outer brown layer of rice called chaff -rice husk-.

ingredients.name: Roasted turkey including natural turkey juices
Rose apple
ingredients.whatItIs: A rose apple -Syzygium jambos or related species- is a tropical fruit native to Southeast Asia and the Indian subcontinent. Despite its name, it's not related to either roses or apples — it belongs to the myrtle family. Pear- or bell-shaped fruit, usually pale yellow, white, pink, or red, with a waxy, smooth skin. Mildly sweet with a subtle floral aroma reminiscent of roses.

ingredients.name: Rosé wine
ingredients.whatItIs: A ROSÉ is a type of wine that incorporates some of the color from the grape skins, but not enough to qualify it as a red wine.

ingredients.name: Rowal
ingredients.whatItIs: Rowal -scientific name Pangium edule- is a tropical fruit native to Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands. The fruits are generally 15–30 cm long, with a rough brown exterior. The flesh has a strong aroma. The fresh fruit and seeds contain hydrogen cyanide and are DEADLY POISONOUS if consumed without prior preparation.

ingredients.name: Russell's snapper
ingredients.whatItIs: Russell's snapper -Lutjanus russellii- is a species of marine ray-finned fish, a snapper belonging to the family Lutjanidae.

ingredients.name: Rye
ingredients.whatItIs: A cereal grain used mainly in dense breads and crispbreads.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides flavour, structure and fibre in breads and crackers.
ingredients.riskReason: A nutritious wholegrain that contains gluten, so it must be declared and avoided in a coeliac diet.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Safflower seed kernels
ingredients.whatItIs: Safflower seed kernels are the inner, edible part of the seeds from the safflower plant -Carthamus tinctorius-, an oilseed crop in the daisy/thistle family that's related to sunflowers. Safflower kernels are quite high in fat -mostly unsaturated, especially linoleic acid — an omega-6 fatty acid-, along with protein and fiber. They're also a source of vitamin E and various minerals.

ingredients.name: Sago

ingredients.name: Saint Marcellin

ingredients.name: Saint nectaire

ingredients.name: Sainte-Maure de Touraine
ingredients.whatItIs: Le Sainte-maure-de-touraine est un fromage de chèvre1 de la région Centre-Val de Loire, en France. Cette appellation d'origine doit son existence à la commune homonyme Sainte-Maure-de-Touraine. L'appellation Sainte-maure-de-touraine est protégée par un label régional depuis 1978, puis depuis le 29 juin 1990, par une appellation d'origine protégée.

ingredients.name: Saithe
ingredients.whatItIs: The saithe -Pollachius virens- is a species of marine fish in the Pollachius genus.

ingredients.name: Salami

ingredients.name: Salema

ingredients.name: Salers

ingredients.name: Salsa

ingredients.name: Salt (Sodium Chloride)
ingredients.whatItIs: Sodium chloride.
ingredients.whyUsed: Seasons, preserves, controls fermentation and improves texture.
ingredients.riskReason: Essential in small amounts, but high intake raises blood pressure, a leading risk factor for stroke and heart disease. The WHO recommends adults consume less than 5 g of salt, about 2 g of sodium, per day, and most people exceed this.

sources.title: WHO guideline: sodium intake for adults and children

ingredients.name: Sambal
ingredients.whatItIs: Sambal is an Indonesian chili sauce or paste typically made from a mixture of a variety of chili peppers with secondary ingredients such as shrimp paste, garlic, ginger, shallot, scallion, palm sugar, and lime juice.

ingredients.name: Sambal oelek
ingredients.whatItIs: Raw chili paste -bright red, thin and sharp tasting-. Can be used as the base for making other sambals or as an ingredient for other cuisines.

ingredients.name: Sapodilla
ingredients.whatItIs: Sapodilla -Manilkara zapota- is a tropical fruit native to southern Mexico, Central America, and the Caribbean. It's a small to medium-sized fruit with rough, brown, potato-like skin. The flesh inside is yellowish-brown, soft, and grainy in texture. Often described as one of the sweetest fruits in the world. It has a rich, caramel-like or brown sugar flavor, sometimes with hints of vanilla and pear.

ingredients.name: Sasa veitchii
ingredients.whatItIs: large species of bamboo grass

ingredients.name: Sea-buckthorn
ingredients.whatItIs: Hippophae rhamnoides, also known as SEA-BUCKTHORN is a species of flowering plant in the family Elaeagnaceae, native to the cold-temperate regions of Europe and Asia.

ingredients.name: Sea lettuce
ingredients.whatItIs: The sea lettuces comprise the genus Ulva, a group of edible green algae that is widely distributed along the coasts of the world's oceans.

ingredients.name: Seabream
ingredients.whatItIs: The Sparidae are a family of fish in the order Perciformes, commonly called sea breams and porgies.

ingredients.name: Selenium

ingredients.name: Sémillon

ingredients.name: Sequestrant

ingredients.name: Sesame

ingredients.whyUsed: Used in breads, snacks, oils and pastes such as tahini and hummus.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritious, and a declarable allergen in the EU, UK and, since 2023, the United States.

ingredients.name: Shea butter

Occasionally, shea butter is mixed with other oils as a substitute for cocoa butter, although the taste is noticeably different.

ingredients.name: Sheeps milk
ingredients.whatItIs: Sheep's milk -or ewes' milk- is the milk of domestic sheep.

ingredients.name: Shellfish
ingredients.whatItIs: Shellfish is a food source and fisheries term for exoskeleton-bearing aquatic invertebrates used as food, including various species of molluscs, crustaceans, and echinoderms.

ingredients.name: Shorea robusta seed oil

ingredients.name: Sichuan pepper
