ingredients.name: Skipjack tuna
ingredients.whatItIs: The skipjack tuna -Katsuwonus pelamis- is a medium-sized perciform fish in the tuna family, Scombridae.

ingredients.name: Sodium
ingredients.whatItIs: SODIUM is a chemical element with symbol Na -from Latin natrium- and atomic number 11. In humans, sodium is an essential mineral that regulates blood volume, blood pressure, osmotic equilibrium and pH; the minimum physiological requirement for sodium is 500 milligrams per day.

ingredients.name: Sodium iodide
ingredients.whatItIs: Sodium iodide -chemical formula NaI- is an ionic compound formed from the chemical reaction of sodium metal and iodine.

ingredients.name: Sodium molybdate
ingredients.whatItIs: SODIUM MOLYBDATE, Na2MoO4, is useful as a source of molybdenum.

ingredients.name: Sodium selenate
ingredients.whatItIs: SODIUM SELENATE is the inorganic compound with the formula Na2SeO4. Chosen for its selenium content and high solubility, sodium selenate is a common ingredient in over-the-counter vitamin supplements.

ingredients.name: Sodium selenite
ingredients.whatItIs: SODIUM SELENITE is the inorganic compound with the formula Na2SeO3. Because selenium is an essential element, sodium selenite is an ingredient in dietary supplements such as multi-vitamin/mineral products.

ingredients.name: Soft cheese made from pasteurized milk
Sourdough
ingredients.whatItIs: Sourdough bread is made by the fermentation of dough using naturally occurring lactobacilli and yeast.

ingredients.name: Soursop
ingredients.whatItIs: Soursop is a tropical fruit from the Annona muricata tree, native to the Caribbean, Central America, and parts of South America and Africa. Large, green, spiky/prickly on the outside — it can weigh anywhere from 1 to 7 kg. The inside is white, creamy, and fibrous with large black seeds. It's taste is an unique blend of sweet and tangy — often described as a mix of strawberry, pineapple, and citrus, with a creamy texture somewhat like banana or coconut.

ingredients.name: South African hake
ingredients.whatItIs: Merluccius capensis -shallow-water Cape hake or South African hake- is a ray-finned fish in the genus Merluccius, found in the south-eastern Atlantic Ocean, along the coast of South Africa.

ingredients.name: Soya
ingredients.whatItIs: The soya bean and its many derived ingredients.
ingredients.whyUsed: A major source of protein, oil and emulsifiers across processed foods.
ingredients.riskReason: A nutritious protein source. Soya is one of the 14 allergens that must always be declared.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Soy milk
ingredients.whatItIs: SOY MILK or soymilk is a plant-based drink produced by soaking and grinding soybeans, boiling the mixture, and filtering out remaining particulates.

ingredients.name: Soya oil
ingredients.whatItIs: SOYBEAN OIL is a vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of the soybean -Glycine max-.

ingredients.name: Speculoos
ingredients.whatItIs: Speculaas or its variant speculoos is a type of spiced shortcrust biscuit.

ingredients.name: Spices and Herbs
ingredients.whatItIs: Dried plant parts used for flavour and aroma.
ingredients.whyUsed: Season and flavour almost every savoury category.
ingredients.riskReason: No concern at culinary levels. The generic term 'spices' does not tell you which ones are present, which matters if you react to a specific spice.

ingredients.name: Spiny lobster
ingredients.whatItIs: SPINY LOBSTERS, also known as langustas, langouste, or rock lobsters, are a family -Palinuridae- of about 60 species of achelate crustaceans

ingredients.name: Squeezed apple juice
synonyms: Apple juice from fresh pressed apples
ingredients.whatItIs: apple juice that does NOT come from concentrated apple juice

ingredients.name: Stabiliser
ingredients.whatItIs: Stabilisers are substances which make it possible to maintain the physico-chemical state of a foodstuff; stabilisers include substances which enable the maintenance of a homogenous dispersion of two or more immiscible substances in a foodstuff, substances which stabilise, retain or intensify an existing colour of a foodstuff and substances which increase the binding capacity of the food, including the formation of cross-links between proteins enabling the binding of food pieces into re-constituted food.

ingredients.name: Strawberry guavas
ingredients.whatItIs: Strawberry guava -Psidium cattleianum- is a tropical fruit tree native to eastern Brazil. The flesh is white to creamy, with a sweet-tart taste reminiscent of a mix between strawberry and guava — hence the name. It contains small, hard seeds.

ingredients.name: Striped bass
ingredients.whatItIs: The striped bass -Morone saxatilis-, also called the Atlantic striped bass, striper, linesider, rock or rockfish, is an anadromous perciform fish of the family Moronidae found primarily along the Atlantic coast of North America.

ingredients.name: Sugar (Sucrose)
ingredients.whatItIs: Table sugar, refined from sugar cane or sugar beet.
ingredients.whyUsed: Sweetens, bulks, browns and preserves an enormous range of foods.
ingredients.riskReason: Not toxic, but a leading contributor of free sugars, which are linked to tooth decay, weight gain and type 2 diabetes risk. The WHO recommends free sugars stay below 10 percent of daily energy intake, and suggests under 5 percent for additional benefit.

sources.title: WHO guideline on sugars intake for adults and children

ingredients.name: Sugar apple
ingredients.whatItIs: A sugar apple -also called sweetsop- is a tropical fruit from the Annona squamosa tree, native to the tropical Americas and West Indies. It has a bumpy, knobby green skin made up of overlapping segments that look almost like scales or a pinecone. When ripe, the segments separate easily. The white, creamy flesh inside is sweet and custard-like — hence "sugar" apple. The taste is often described as a blend of vanilla, pear, and banana, with a grainy, melt-in-your-mouth texture.

ingredients.name: Sultana
ingredients.whatItIs: SULTANA is a "white" -pale green-, oval seedless grape variety also called the sultanina, Thompson Seedless, Lady de Coverly, and oval-fruited Kishmish.

ingredients.name: Sundried tomatoes
ingredients.whatItIs: Sun-dried tomatoes are ripe tomatoes that lose most of their water content after spending a majority of their drying time in the sun.

ingredients.name: Sunflower Oil
ingredients.whatItIs: An oil pressed from sunflower seeds, high in unsaturated fat.
ingredients.whyUsed: Frying, baking and as a base for spreads and dressings.
ingredients.riskReason: A predominantly unsaturated fat. Dietary guidelines favour unsaturated oils over saturated fats.

sources.title: WHO guideline: saturated and trans-fatty acid intake

ingredients.name: Superior quality Camargue long grain rice
Superior quality long grain Basmati rice
synonyms: high quality long grain Basmati rice

ingredients.name: Superior quality long grain parboiled brown rice
Superior quality long grain parboiled rice
Superior quality long grain white rice
Superior quality organic long grain rice
Sweet bean paste
ingredients.whatItIs: food ingredient used throughout East Asian cuisine, primarily as a filling for sweet desserts and pastries.

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.whatItIs: The SWEET POTATO -Ipomoea batatas- is a dicotyledonous plant that belongs to the bindweed or morning glory family, Convolvulaceae.

ingredients.name: Sweet potato puree cooked with cream
Sweetener
ingredients.whatItIs: Sweeteners are substances used to impart a sweet taste to foods or in table-top sweeteners.

ingredients.name: Swordfish
ingredients.whatItIs: Swordfish -Xiphias gladius-, also known as broadbills in some countries, are large, highly migratory, predatory fish characterized by a long, flat bill.

ingredients.name: Sylvaner
ingredients.whatItIs: Sylvaner or Silvaner is a variety of white wine grape grown primarily in Alsace and Germany, where its official name is Grüner Silvaner.

ingredients.name: Syrah
ingredients.whatItIs: Syrah, also known as Shiraz, is a dark-skinned grape variety grown throughout the world and used primarily to produce red wine.

ingredients.name: Syrup
ingredients.whatItIs: SYRUP is a condiment that is a thick, viscous liquid consisting primarily of a solution of sugar in water, containing a large amount of dissolved sugars but showing little tendency to deposit crystals.

ingredients.name: Tapioca
ingredients.whatItIs: TAPIOCA is a starch extracted from cassava root -tapioca seems to be the same as tapioca starch, but not used as such on ingredient lists-

ingredients.name: Tarragon
ingredients.whatItIs: TARRAGON -Artemisia dracunculus-, is a species of perennial herb in the sunflower family. Tarragon is one of the four fines herbes of French cooking, and is particularly suitable for chicken, fish, and egg dishes.

ingredients.name: Taurine
ingredients.whatItIs: Taurine is an organic compound that is widely distributed in animal tissues. Taurine has many fundamental biological roles. Taurine is a common additive to energy drinks, which are often promoted as such.

ingredients.name: Tequila
ingredients.whatItIs: TEQUILA is a regional distilled beverage and type of alcoholic drink made from the blue agave plant, primarily in the area surrounding the city of Tequila

ingredients.name: Teran
ingredients.whatItIs: Teran grape is a variety of red grape from Istria, Croatia.

ingredients.name: Thai rice
ingredients.whatItIs: JASMINE RICE is a long-grain variety of fragrant rice -also known as aromatic rice-. Its fragrance, reminiscent of jasmine and popcorn, results from the rice plant's natural production of aromatic compounds

ingredients.name: Thickener
ingredients.whatItIs: Thickeners are substances which increase the viscosity of a foodstuff.

ingredients.name: Thongweed
ingredients.whatItIs: HIMANTHALIA ELONGATA is a brown alga -class Phaeophyta or Phaeophyceae- in the order Fucales, also known by the common names thongweed, sea thong and sea spaghetti.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.whatItIs: THYME is an aromatic perennial evergreen herb with culinary, medicinal, and ornamental uses. The most common variety is Thymus vulgaris.

ingredients.name: Toasted sesame oil
ingredients.whatItIs: “Oil made from toasted seeds is used for its distinctive nutty aroma and taste, although it may be unsuitable for frying, which makes it taste burnt and bitter.” -Wikipedia-

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.whatItIs: A fruit used as a vegetable, often concentrated into purée or paste.
ingredients.whyUsed: Base for sauces, soups, ketchup and ready meals.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritious and a source of lycopene. Tomatoes are naturally high in glutamate, which is why they taste savoury.

sources.title: EFSA opinion on lycopene as a food colour and nutrient

ingredients.name: Tomme
ingredients.whatItIs: TOMME, occasionally spelled Tome, is a class of cheese produced mainly in the French Alps and in Switzerland.

ingredients.name: Tomme de Savoie
ingredients.whatItIs: Tomme de Savoie is an upland variety of Tomme cheese, specifically, one from Savoy in the French Alps.

ingredients.name: Tree gum
ingredients.whatItIs: sap or other resinous material associated with certain species of the plant kingdom -Wikidata-

ingredients.name: Tree Nuts
ingredients.whatItIs: Nuts grown on trees, including almond, hazelnut, walnut, cashew, pistachio, pecan, Brazil nut and macadamia.
ingredients.whyUsed: Used in confectionery, baking, spreads, cereals and plant milks.
ingredients.riskReason: Nutritious, but a major allergen group that must always be declared, and a common cause of severe reactions.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Turkey meat
ingredients.whatItIs: TURKEY MEAT, commonly referred to as just turkey, is the meat from turkeys, typically domesticated turkeys. Turkeys are sold sliced and ground, as well as "whole" in a manner similar to chicken with the head, feet, and feathers removed. Frozen whole turkeys remain popular. Sliced turkey is frequently used as a sandwich meat or served as cold cuts.

ingredients.name: Unrefined sea salt from the Atlantic
Uridine monophosphate
ingredients.whatItIs: URIDINE MONOPHOSPHATE -UMP- is a nucleotide that is used as a monomer in RNA.

ingredients.name: Vanillin
ingredients.whatItIs: The main aroma compound of vanilla, usually produced synthetically.
ingredients.whyUsed: Gives vanilla flavour to chocolate, baked goods, ice cream and drinks.
ingredients.riskReason: An authorised flavouring substance with no safety concern at use levels.

sources.title: EU Union list of authorised flavouring substances

ingredients.name: Vermouth
ingredients.whatItIs: A dry, or sweet apéritif wine flavored with aromatic herbs, and often used in mixed drinks.

ingredients.name: Vine spinach
ingredients.whatItIs: Vine spinach -also called Malabar spinach- is a tropical leafy green plant, not a true spinach but used similarly in cooking. It's especially popular in Indian, Filipino, and West African cooking, where it goes by various local names like poi saag -India- or slippery vegetable.

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.whatItIs: A dilute acetic acid solution made by fermentation.
ingredients.whyUsed: Acidifies, preserves and adds sourness to pickles, sauces and dressings.
ingredients.riskReason: No safety concern. Malt vinegar is made from barley, so it is relevant to a strict gluten-free diet.

sources.title: EFSA re-evaluation of acetic acid and its salts

ingredients.name: Walnut oil
ingredients.whatItIs: WALNUT OIL is oil extracted from walnuts, Juglans regia

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.whatItIs: Water, usually the largest ingredient by weight in drinks, sauces and many processed foods.
ingredients.whyUsed: Dissolves, dilutes, hydrates and carries other ingredients.
ingredients.riskReason: No concern. Worth noting only because when water is listed first it means the product is mostly water.

ingredients.name: Water spinach
ingredients.whatItIs: Water convolvulus -Ipomoea aquatica-, also known as water spinach, morning glory, or kangkong, is a semi-aquatic tropical plant widely used as a leafy vegetable across Asia and Africa. It's a staple vegetable in cuisines across Southeast Asia -Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia-. Both the leaves and tender stem tips are eaten, typically stir-fried with garlic, shrimp paste, or chili.

ingredients.name: Welsh onion
ingredients.whatItIs: Allium fistulosum, the Welsh onion, also commonly called bunching onion, long green onion, Japanese bunching onion, and spring onion, is a species of perennial plant. A. fistulosum is an ingredient in Asian cuisine, especially in East and Southeast Asia. In the West, A. fistulosum is primarily used as a scallion or salad onion.

ingredients.name: Wheat Flour
ingredients.whatItIs: Milled wheat grain, the base of most bread, pasta and baked goods.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides structure, bulk and texture in baking.
ingredients.riskReason: A dietary staple. It contains gluten, so it must be declared as an allergen and strictly avoided by people with coeliac disease or wheat allergy.

sources.title: EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex II: allergens requiring declaration

ingredients.name: Whey protein
ingredients.whatItIs: WHEY PROTEIN is a mixture of globular proteins isolated from whey, the liquid material created as a by-product of cheese production.

ingredients.name: White chocolate
ingredients.whatItIs: WHITE CHOCOLATE is made of sugar, milk, and cocoa butter, without the cocoa solids. It is pale ivory colour, and lacks many of the compounds found in milk and dark chocolates.

ingredients.name: White walnut
ingredients.whatItIs: Butternuts -Juglans cinerea-, also called white walnuts, are a species of walnut tree native to eastern North America. The nutmeats are eaten and used in baking.

ingredients.name: White wine
ingredients.whatItIs: WHITE WINE is a wine whose colour can be straw-yellow, yellow-green, or yellow-gold.

ingredients.name: Whiteleg shrimp
ingredients.whatItIs: Whiteleg shrimp -Litopenaeus vannamei, formerly Penaeus vannamei-, also known as Pacific white shrimp or king prawn, is a variety of prawn of the eastern Pacific Ocean commonly caught or farmed for food.

ingredients.name: Whole rye and durum wheat sourdough
Winged beans
ingredients.whatItIs: Winged beans -Psophocarpus tetragonolobus- are a tropical legume known for their distinctive four-sided, ruffled or "winged" pods — the edges look like jagged ribbons running down the length of each pod. Almost the entire plant is edible: pods, seeds, leaves, flowers, and even the tuberous roots can all be eaten. That's unusual among legumes. High in protein: the seeds in particular are very protein- and nutrient-dense, which is part of why they've been studied as a potential "supercrop" for tropical regions. Native to Southeast Asia and New Guinea, and widely grown across South and Southeast Asia, as well as parts of Africa.

ingredients.name: Wort
ingredients.whatItIs: Liquid extracted from the mashing process during brewing.

ingredients.name: Xylanase
ingredients.whatItIs: Xylanase is any of a class of enzymes that degrade the linear polysaccharide xylan into xylose,[1] thus breaking down hemicellulose, one of the major components of plant cell walls.

ingredients.name: Yam
ingredients.whatItIs: Yam is the common name for some plant species in the genus Dioscorea -family Dioscoreaceae- that form edible tubers. In some places, other -unrelated- root vegetables are sometimes referred to as "yams".

ingredients.name: Yambean
ingredients.whatItIs: Yambean is a tropical legume -in the bean family, Fabaceae- grown primarily for its large, starchy, edible tuber/root. Native to Mexico and Central America, widely cultivated across Latin America and Southeast Asia. Mildly sweet, very crunchy, similar to a cross between an apple and a water chestnut — it stays crisp even when cooked.

ingredients.name: Yardlong beans
ingredients.whatItIs: Yardlong beans -also called Chinese long beans, snake beans, or asparagus beans- are a type of legume known for their dramatically long, slender pods — typically 12 to 30 inches long, though they're usually picked and sold around 18 inches. They have a slightly nuttier, more savory flavor than regular green beans, with a denser, chewier texture that holds up well to high-heat cooking like stir-frying. They're a staple in Chinese, Southeast Asian -especially Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino-, and South Asian cooking.

ingredients.name: Yautia
ingredients.whatItIs: Yautia -also called malanga or taro coco- is a starchy root vegetable widely used in Latin American and Caribbean cuisine. Earthy, slightly nutty flavor, denser and less slimy than taro. When cooked, it becomes soft and starchy — similar to a potato but with more depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Yeast
ingredients.whatItIs: A single-celled fungus used for fermentation.
ingredients.whyUsed: Raises bread and ferments beer and wine.
ingredients.riskReason: No safety concern as a food ingredient.

sources.title: EFSA opinion on yeast as a food ingredient

ingredients.name: Yeast Extract
ingredients.whatItIs: Concentrated yeast cell contents, naturally rich in free glutamates.
ingredients.whyUsed: Adds savoury depth to spreads, crisps, soups and stocks. Often used where a label avoids declaring added MSG.
ingredients.riskReason: A food ingredient rather than an additive, with no safety concern. It naturally contains glutamate, so people who believe they react to MSG may react similarly. It is also high in purines.

sources.title: EFSA (2017) re-evaluation of glutamic acid and glutamates

ingredients.name: Yellowfin tuna
ingredients.whatItIs: The yellowfin tuna -Thunnus albacares- is a species of tuna found in pelagic waters of tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.

ingredients.name: Yogurt from pasteurized milk with 3 5 milk fat
Yogurt from pasteurized milk with milk fat
Young Mimolette
synonyms: young Mimolette cheese from cow's milk

ingredients.name: Zinc
ingredients.whatItIs: ZINC is a chemical element with symbol Zn and atomic number 30.

ingredients.name: Zinc gluconate
ingredients.whatItIs: ZINC GLUCONATE  is the zinc salt of gluconic acid. It is an ionic compound consisting of two anions of gluconate for each zincII cation. Zinc gluconate is a popular form for the delivery of zinc as a dietary supplement

ingredients.name: Zinc oxide
ingredients.whatItIs: ZINC OXIDE is an inorganic compound with the formula ZnO. Zinc oxide is added to many food products, including breakfast cereals, as a source of zinc, a necessary nutrient.

ingredients.name: Zinc sulfate
ingredients.whatItIs: ZINC SULFATE has the formula ZnSO4 as well as any of three hydrates. As a supplement it is used to treat zinc deficiency and to prevent the condition in those at high risk.

ingredients.name: Ōhelo berry
ingredients.whatItIs: ʻŌhelo is a small, native Hawaiian shrub in the cranberry family, commonly found at high elevations on the islands of Maui and Hawaiʻi. Ōhelo is related to the cranberry but much less tart — mildly sweet and mildly tart, with a texture similar to cranberries or blueberries.
